scientific_integrity: Proof gives the full conditional law, explicit couplings, zero covariance by degree-sum conservation, and a rigorous uniform-integrability asymptotic. The finite checker supports but does not prove the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled Cayley trees, n>=4; stochastic dominance only for the specified adjacent degrees; single-vertex conditional prediction; earlier equivalent multivariate occupancy identity not excluded.
title: A stochastic valley and a sharp nonlinear dependence scale for leaves of uniform labeled trees
